topics.name: Why do we balance equations?
topics.juniorOpening: Bhaiya/didi, mujhe ye balancing samajh hi nahi aati. Equation aise hi likh do na, balance kyun karna hai?

points.text: Atoms can neither be created nor destroyed in a reaction (law of conservation of mass).
So each element must have equal atoms on both sides of the equation.
We balance by changing the numbers (coefficients) in front of formulas, never the formulas themselves.
An unbalanced equation is wrong because it breaks that law.

followUps: Par atoms kahan gaye phir? Reaction mein atoms toot te nahi kya?
Matlab left side aur right side same atoms? Ek example do na!
Number kahan change karte hain? Formula ke andar wale chhote number bhi badal sakte hain kya?
Agar balance na karo toh kya bigad jayega, seriously?
topics.gotIt: OHHH! Ab samjha - atoms same rakhne hote hain dono side, isliye coefficients badalte hain. Tum toh teacher se bhi achhe samjhate ho!

topics.name: Decomposition reactions and their types
topics.juniorOpening: Yaar ye decomposition reaction kya hota hai? Aur uske types bhi hain?? Confused hu totally.

points.text: One reactant breaks down into two or more products.
Thermal decomposition uses heat, e.g. CaCO3 -> CaO + CO2.
Electrolytic decomposition uses electricity, e.g. 2H2O -> 2H2 + O2.
Photolytic decomposition uses light, e.g. 2AgCl -> 2Ag + Cl2.

followUps: Ek cheez toot ke alag alag ban jati hai? Example do na please!
Heat se kaise tootta hai? Koi real example?
Electricity se bhi toot sakta hai?? Kaise?
Aur light se? Seriously, dhoop se reaction hoti hai?
topics.gotIt: Samajh gaya! Thermal = heat, electrolytic = current, photolytic = light - teeno mein ek reactant tootta hai. Kal exam mein pakka yaad rahega!

topics.name: Exothermic vs endothermic
topics.juniorOpening: Exo-endo mein hamesha confuse ho jata hu. Kaunsa heat deta hai, kaunsa leta hai? Simple mein batao na.

points.text: Exothermic reactions release heat/energy.
Examples: burning, respiration, quicklime + water.
Endothermic reactions absorb heat/energy.
Examples: thermal decomposition of CaCO3, photosynthesis.

followUps: Release matlab? Garam hota hai kya reaction? Example?
Respiration mein heat kaise nikalti hai, hum toh jalte nahi?
Toh endothermic mein thanda ho jata hai kya? Example batao na.
Photosynthesis mein heat kahan se aati hai?
topics.gotIt: Exo = heat bahar, endo = heat andar! Respiration aur burning exo, CaCO3 ka decomposition endo. Easy tha ye toh, thanks!

topics.name: Oxidation, reduction and redox
topics.juniorOpening: Oxidation-reduction suna hai but kabhi samajh nahi aaya. Redox kya hota hai bhaiya/didi?

points.text: Oxidation = gain of oxygen or loss of hydrogen.
Reduction = loss of oxygen or gain of hydrogen.
Both happen together - that is why it is called a redox reaction.
Example: CuO + H2 -> Cu + H2O, CuO reduced, H2 oxidised.

followUps: Oxygen judna = oxidation? Toh reduction mein kya hota hai?
Dono ek saath kaise ho sakte hain? Ek hi reaction mein?
Ek example se samjhao na, formula wala!
Toh CuO + H2 wale mein kiska oxidation, kiska reduction?
topics.gotIt: Aha! Oxidation aur reduction hamesha saath hote hain - isliye redox. CuO ka oxygen H2 ko mil gaya, sorted!

topics.name: Corrosion, rusting and rancidity
topics.juniorOpening: Cycle kyun rust ho jati hai aur chips kyun stale? Corrosion aur rancidity same hai kya?

points.text: Corrosion: metal slowly destroyed by reaction with air/moisture around it.
Rusting of iron: hydrated iron oxide Fe2O3.xH2O forms.
Prevention: painting, oiling, galvanisation.
Rancidity: oxidation of oils/fats in food; prevented by airtight packing, antioxidants, nitrogen flushing.

followUps: Metal hawa se react karta hai? Har metal?
Rust ka formula kya hai, exam mein aata hai kya?
Rust rokne ke liye kya kare? Ghar pe kya karte hain?
Aur chips packet mein nitrogen kyun bharte hain?
topics.gotIt: Clear hai! Corrosion = metal ka kharab hona, rancidity = food ke fats ka oxidation. Dono oxidation hi hai basically!
